title: Conflict Check Intake Form
subtitle: A controlled intake and triage record for a pre-engagement or new-party conflicts search that maps clients, adversaries, affiliates, witnesses, lawyers, prior matters, search terms, possible hits, analysis routing, and final clearance restrictions, carrying facts and source evidence through qualified decision, exception escalation, secure communication, and accountable handoff.
description: This original Conflict Check Intake Form helps the conflicts analyst and authorized ethics reviewer manage a pre-engagement or new-party conflicts search that maps clients, adversaries, affiliates, witnesses, lawyers, prior matters, search terms, possible hits, analysis routing, and final clearance restrictions. It opens the record, classifies the request, captures source facts and urgency, and routes a qualified accept, defer, decline, or escalation decision, while keeping jurisdiction-specific conclusions and professional judgment with authorized reviewers.
use_case: Use when the conflicts analyst and authorized ethics reviewer needs one fillable record that opens the record, classifies the request, captures source facts and urgency, and routes a qualified accept, defer, decline, or escalation decision for the conflict-search request. Close only after the intake disposition is supported by evidence and accepted by the named recipient.

sections.title: Conflict Check record identity and routing
sections.guidance: Open one traceable record, establish authority, and assign accountable qualified review.

blocks.label: Conflict Check record and responsible parties
Intake and Triage timing and route
Confidential record boundary
blocks.guidance: Use approved secure systems for protected communications and source files. Do not enter access credentials, complete account numbers, government identifiers, medical detail, or privileged source content in this routing form.

sections.title: Conflict Check facts and source evidence
sections.guidance: Capture domain-specific facts, distinguish statements from verified evidence, and retain source references.

blocks.label: Conflict Check matter profile
Conflict Check evidence checkpoints
items: Proposed client and client-side affiliates are identified with aliases
Adverse parties, affiliates, principals, and known aligned persons are listed
Witnesses, experts, insurers, lenders, and other material relationships are mapped
Matter description is specific enough to compare subject and transaction overlap
Search terms include former names, trade names, spellings, and entity parents
Every possible hit preserves its source matter and relationship context
Search output is treated as evidence for review, not an automated clearance
Sensitive prospective-client information is limited and access controlled
blocks.guidance: Check only supported items; explain any limitation in the evidence narrative.

blocks.label: Conflict Check evidence and action register
blocks.guidance: Reference approved repositories; do not copy confidential source contents into the table.

blocks.label: Possible-hit context, relationship dates, matter similarity, adversity, confidential information, and facts requiring ethics review

fields.label: Possible-hit context, relationship dates, matter similarity, adversity, confidential information, and facts requiring ethics review

sections.title: Conflict Check intake and triage control record
sections.guidance: Turn the record purpose into traceable evidence, accountable actions, and reviewable decisions.

blocks.label: Requested outcome, contact, and triage basis
Conflict Check intake interview controls
items: The proposed client and related persons describes the requested outcome in their own terms
The conflict-search request is classified before any substantive action
Material dates, amounts, persons, and assumptions are read back for confirmation
Statements are visibly separated from verified records and third-party reports
Only necessary information is requested through an approved secure route
Language, access, accommodation, and communication needs are routed
No promise of representation, result, filing, clearance, or deadline action is made
Urgent, suspicious, unsafe, or professionally restricted matters are escalated

blocks.label: Initial question, response, and evidence map
Neutral intake summary, unresolved questions, and proposed next step

fields.label: Neutral intake summary, unresolved questions, and proposed next step

sections.title: Conflict Check stop conditions, exceptions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Stop when authority, identity, evidence, deadline, confidentiality, or professional-duty controls are unresolved.

blocks.label: Stop and escalate when any condition is present
items: A proposed representation appears directly adverse to a current client
Former-client work may be the same as or substantially related to this matter
A prospective-client consultation may have exposed significantly harmful information
Responsibilities to another client or person may materially limit representation
A lawyer's financial, personal, family, or prior-role interest may be implicated
A hit may be imputed across lawyers, offices, affiliates, or a lateral-hire team
Necessary disclosure cannot be made without revealing protected information
The issue may be nonconsentable or requires withdrawal, screening, or outside advice
blocks.guidance: A checked item requires immediate protective action, a named owner, qualified review, and a final disposition.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage exception and escalation register
Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

fields.label: Objective facts, affected activity, containment, notifications, and review needed

blocks.label: Qualified review and record boundary
blocks.guidance: This template records operational facts and does not determine legal rights, professional duties, privilege, conflicts, consentability, deadlines, or court compliance. Follow applicable jurisdictional rules and current firm policy; route legal, ethics, privacy, tax, court, safety, and specialist questions to authorized reviewers.

sections.title: Conflict Check qualified decision and accountable authorization
sections.guidance: Record the authorized decision separately from preliminary analysis and prevent action beyond its evidence and scope.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage qualified decision
Conflict Check decision and execution conditions
items: Qualified reviewer confirms the complete client and adverse-party identity map
Each possible hit has a disposition supported by source-matter facts
Current, former, and prospective-client duties are analyzed separately
Consentability, screening, notice, and withdrawal questions are not automated
Any required written informed consent is stored in the approved system
Clearance limits, affected lawyers, and recheck triggers are operationally explicit
blocks.guidance: Check only controls supported by cited evidence; unresolved items remain open conditions.

blocks.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

fields.label: Evidence considered, reasons, limits, alternatives, and required follow-up

blocks.label: Preparation, qualified review, and independent authorization
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and scope; they do not replace required agreements, consents, notices, filings, or system approvals.

blocks.label: Decision-use limitation
blocks.guidance: Do not use this Conflict Check record as a substitute for legal advice, a required client agreement, informed consent, court paper, discovery response, privilege review, or specialist determination. Execute only the action evidenced in the approved system of record.

sections.title: Conflict Check completion, evidence reconciliation, and handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when the outcome is evidenced, limitations remain visible, and every open action has an accountable owner.

blocks.label: Intake and Triage outcome and primary handoff
Conflict Check closeout evidence
items: Final cleared, conditional, declined, or escalated status is recorded
Reviewer rationale and applicable jurisdictional rule source are referenced
Conditions, screens, consents, notices, and access limits have accountable owners
Search terms and hit dispositions remain available for later recheck
Matter opening is blocked unless the exact clearance conditions are met
New parties, affiliates, claims, lawyers, or lateral hires trigger re-screening
blocks.guidance: Unchecked items require an exception disposition or a documented reopen trigger.
